svg.title: The chat ends, the repository remembers
svg.desc: The chat ends, the repository remembers. Session 1: Ask for the change, Check the work, Inspect project health, Hand off. Repository files: AGENTS.md, docs/STATUS.md, docs/handoff/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md, src/demo/__init__.py, tests/test_smoke.py. Session 2: Start the next session. Chat history: not carried over. The repository carries the recorded state; chat history is not carried over.
